Definition: from G1909 and the base of G202; to listen (intently) to:--hear.
BiblicalUsage: At midnight Paul and Silas prayed and sang praises to God in Acts 16:25, and the prisoners heard them — listening intently in the dark to men in chains singing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe praise in prison is the loudest sermon there is, and the prisoners heard it because no one can sing like that without a reason.
RelatedEvents: Paul and Silas in the Philippian Prison
